title: Harness Companion config
description: Versioned project-level configuration consumed by harness-companion scripts. Schema version is bumped on backwards-incompatible changes.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Bumped on backwards-incompatible changes.

project_type.description: Detected project ecosystem. Used by audit and to choose example configs.

min_required_for_passing.description: Subset of verification command ids that MUST pass for a feature to be marked 'passing'. Empty array means 'no command is required' — useful for documentation-only repos.

wip_limit.description: Maximum number of features allowed in 'in_progress' status simultaneously. Default 1.

allow_force.description: Whether the --force flag is honored at all on harness-feature.sh.

id.description: Stable identifier used in evidence records and audit output.

command.description: Command to execute as an argv array. Each element is a separate argument; harness-companion does NOT perform shell interpolation.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum runtime before we forcibly kill the command and treat it as failed.

required_for_passing.description: Whether this command must pass for a feature to be marked passing.

applies_when.description: Predicate evaluated against the project. If true (or absent) the command runs.
